name: MeMo Dev Container
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake libgtest-dev git ca-certificates && if [ -d /usr/src/gtest ]; then sudo cmake -S /usr/src/gtest -B /usr/src/gtest/build && sudo cmake --build /usr/src/gtest/build && sudo cp /usr/src/gtest/build/libgtest*.a /usr/lib || true; fi
